form.notes: Part I Tax (lines 1-3); Part II Other Taxes (lines 4-21). Line 1 has sub-lines a-f, y and z. Line 17 has sub-lines a-q and z. Line 10 is 'Reserved for future use' for 2025; for 2024 it was the repayment of the first-time homebuyer credit (Form 5405). That obligation was RETIRED, not moved: the 15-year repayment period for 2008 purchases ended with the TY2024 return, and Form 5405 is no longer revised. There is no 2025 destination for it anywhere on the return. Line 20 (section 965 installment) is NOT included in the line 21 total.
